summary: Tested the BRSF 'Late Days' column and the Finalize/Reopen month lock end to end on the LOCAL DB. Backend: the new suite tests/test_brsf_finalize_late_days.py passed 10/10. It covered: late_count is null before calculation and 4/3 after recalculation; finalize works and a second finalize returns 400; while finalized, recalculate (whole month and single employee), override, reset-override, manual, instances add/edit/delete, child-override and its reset, import preview and import confirm all return 400 with the exact 'September 2026 is finalized...' message; XLSX and CSV export still work; values stay frozen after a new late attendance was inserted for TEST_N09_three (N09 still 0, late_count still 3), and after reopen + recalculate they move to -1 / 4; reopen with no reason or a blank reason returns 400, and reopening a month that is already open returns 400; the history has entries finalize then reopen; finalizing without a prior calculation snapshots 15 lines for each employee; sysadmin gets 403 on finalize and reopen. Regression: test_brsf_n09_late_arrivals.py passed 12/12. UI: the Late Days column shows '--' before calculation and then 4 (red) and 3 (slate); grid cards show 'Late Days: n' with the same colours; Finalize dialog with note, then confirm, then the banner appears, Auto Calculate and Import are disabled, Reopen Month shows and Export stays enabled. The lock still shows after a page reload. In employee detail, all override, manual and add-instance buttons are disabled. Reopen with an empty reason keeps the dialog open with the toast 'Please enter a reason to reopen'; with a reason, the banner goes away and editing works again. All test data was cleaned up (0 test employees, locks, lines, audits, batches or attendance left).

issues: Title shows raw 'Finalize 2026-09' while the toast and banner say 'September 2026' (cosmetic inconsistency)
The finalize sign-off note is not shown in the finalized banner (optional)

action_items: Optional: show the month label (e.g. 'September 2026') in the lock dialog title
critical_code_review_comments: brsf_stars frozen branch: an employee who becomes eligible after the month is finalized (e.g. confirmation date changed afterwards) has no stored lines, so the API returns lines=[] with zero totals and nothing tells HR why. Consider flagging this case or snapshotting on read.
Non-finalized GET /api/brsf/stars still runs sync_lines (a write on read). This is existing behaviour, but it means opening an employee's detail makes the summary show 'Calculated'.
month_lock returns the whole lock document, including the growing history array, on every summary/stars call. Fine at current scale; projecting the history out would keep the payload small.
brsf_stars.py is 1115 lines, over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the routes from the engine.
test_credentials: admin/pass123 (local HR) works. /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists admin/HrAdmin@2109, which does NOT work locally. user/pass123 returns 401 locally, so the non-HR 403 check used sysadmin/pass123 (system_admin).
seed_data_creation: Used seed_brsf_late_test_data.py seed; all removed by cleanup (including the 2026-09 lock). Also inserted one extra attendance record for TEST_N09_three and a fake import batch, both removed.
